newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: CSFB issues sell recommendation for Esec.
newsitem.headline: CSFB issues sell recommendation for Esec.

text.p: Credit Suisse First Boston issued a sell recommendation for bearer shares of Esec Holding SA and reduced its earnings forecast for the Swiss manufacturer of semiconductor production machinery.
"The 1996/97 sales were worse than expected. Profit is under pressure on account of higher research and development spending," analyst Andrea Snider said in a research report.
It set a 12-month target of 3,400 Swiss francs for the shares, which were trading at 3,930 around 1235 GMT, up 30.
It cut its fully-diluted EPS estimate to 91 francs from 145 for 1997 and to 123 from 195 for 1998.
